dct_description_sm: Abstract: This layer contains point features of all Cambridge public schools.

Purpose: Created for general use by City staff. Used for both mapping and specific identification of buildings with a similar use. Also used by emergency responders for evacuation and if the school is a designated shelter.

Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
